name: Airports Overlay
description: Worldwide airport markers from OurAirports (~85,000 records). Toggleable map layer with type filters (large, medium, small, heliports, etc.); clicking a marker opens the place panel with runways, frequencies, and navaids.

dataSources.purpose: Render airport markers on the map layer and resolve clicks to a place panel.
dataSources.dataSent: Map viewport bounding box, optionally filtered by airport type.
dataSources.dataReceived: Airport coordinates, name, IATA/ICAO codes, type, elevation, and scheduled-service flag for airports inside the bbox.
